title: The Lovely garden in spring
subtitle: 音乐之声 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 音乐之声（文学艺术与体育·音乐与表演）
meta: 主题语境：音乐之声（文学艺术与体育·音乐与表演）　|　核心词汇：lovely　|　正文 338 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 lovely 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1981 the porter wrote of ① a lovely garden in spring in the journal, and everybody in the coast said at once that it was ② more lovely than the one named there the year before. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the porter, who never explained anything, had done it twice over and gone home; it was the lovely ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most lovely garden in spring anybody in the coast had ever seen, or so the journal for August 1975 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too lovely to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the visitor who had come to help; the lovely ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the bag at the far cove, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a lovely voice of the singer, and said that no visitor in his right mind would call it ⑥ as lovely as the voice of the singer they had once had in the old coast. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was lovely or not, and he said so.

By 1988 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the journal. What the line asked for was ⑦ something lovely, and nothing besides. The visitor from the next coast called the whole plan ⑧ quite lovely; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the journal kept the names of the lovely ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1991, year after year, she wrote of another lovely garden in spring in the same journal, and the work, which took two weeks, seemed ⑨ more lovely than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most lovely voice of the singer in the whole coast, she said in 1993, was the one she could never quite name; the lovely ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 可爱（前置定语 a lovely garden in spring：1981 年挑夫在行记里记下的那件可爱的园子）
B. adj. 可爱／令人愉快（比较级 more lovely than：文中两处，一处比春天里可爱的园子，一处比预想）
C. adj. 可爱／令人愉快（最高级 the most lovely：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 可爱（表语 too lovely to do：母亲觉得它太可爱，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 令人愉快（前置定语 a lovely voice of the singer：叔叔把整件事称作一桩令人愉快的嗓音）
F. adj. 令人愉快（同级比较 as lovely as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩歌手悦耳的嗓音相比）
G. adj. 令人愉快（后置定语 something lovely：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 令人愉快（受程度副词修饰 quite lovely：那位游客的评价）

items.q: the most lovely garden in spring anybody
a lovely voice of the singer
The most lovely voice of the singer in

answers.why: lovely 意为“可爱”，1981 年挑夫在行记里记下的是“一件可爱的园子”，此处作前置定语 a lovely garden in spring。
lovely 意为“可爱”，此处用比较级 more lovely than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
lovely 意为“可爱”，行记上 八月 那行字说它是海岸里最可爱的一件，故用最高级 the most lovely garden in spring。
lovely 意为“可爱”，母亲认为这件东西“太可爱了，谁也用不上”，too lovely to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
lovely 意为“令人愉快”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩令人愉快的嗓音”，此处作前置定语 a lovely voice of the singer。
lovely 意为“令人愉快”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩歌手悦耳的嗓音一样令人愉快”，同级比较用 as lovely as。
lovely 意为“令人愉快”，行记上那半行字要的是“令人愉快的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something lovely。
lovely 意为“令人愉快”，邻海岸来的那位游客认为这套计划“相当令人愉快”，quite 修饰原级 lovely。
lovely 意为“令人愉快”，1991 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要令人愉快”，故用比较级 more lovely than。
lovely 意为“令人愉快”，母亲 1993 年说的是“整个海岸里最令人愉快的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most lovely voice of the singer。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1981 年，挑夫在行记里记下了一件可爱的园子。（a lovely garden in spring）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更可爱。（more lovely than …）
母亲觉得它太可爱，谁也用不上。（too lovely to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩令人愉快的嗓音。（a lovely voice of the singer）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩歌手悦耳的嗓音一样令人愉快。（as lovely as …）
到了 1988 年，行记上只剩半行字：要的是一件令人愉快的东西。（something lovely）
answers: In 1981 the porter wrote of a lovely garden in spring in the journal.
Everybody said it was more lovely than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too lovely to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a lovely voice of the singer.
He said nobody would call it as lovely as the voice of the singer they had once had.
By 1988 the journal asked for nothing but something lovely.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 lovely 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1981 the porter wrote of a lovely garden in spring in the journal, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most lovely garden in spring in the coast, or so the journal says.
My mother thought it too lovely to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a lovely voice of the singer, and nobody argued with him.
The visitor from the next coast called the plan quite lovely, and everybody laughed.
The lovely ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
